items.shows: From echocardiography report to registry field, with the LLM and the rule-based system in parallel and the two centres marked.
items.caption: Figure 1: Study overview. Reports from centre A and centre B were processed by an open-weight large language model (LLM) run on hospital hardware and by a rule-based system, and each output was compared with consensus labels from two cardiologists.

items.shows: Report counts at each step from 1,200 reports to the 200 development and 1,000 test reports, by centre.
items.caption: Figure 2: Flow of reports. Exclusions are shown at each step. Development reports came from centre A only, and test reports came from both centres.

items.caption: Figure 3: Extraction accuracy by lesion, system and centre. (A) Accuracy of the large language model (LLM) and the rule-based system for each lesion, both centres combined. (B) LLM accuracy at centre A and centre B. Points are accuracy and bars are 95% CIs from 2,000 bootstrap resamples. The dashed line marks agreement between the two cardiologists before consensus.
